watch.readinessNote: The Takaro plugin hooks this build by pinned code signatures (proven on game build 1024233 / Steam build 23178631). On any other build every capability self-checks at load and reports degraded; a new build is blocked until the signatures are re-derived and `takaro-maint verify --game enshrouded` reports plugin-health ok (see games/enshrouded/DEVELOPMENT.md).
